user_saw: Running an update could delete another installation’s unfinished handoff directory once it was at least 24 hours old.
summary: The fix removes the global age-based cleanup of managed-service handoff directories from update preparation.
reasoning: The sweeper recursively deleted matching temporary directories based on age alone, without checking ownership or whether the handoff had finished. I checked that #114803 moved an existing sweep behind update admission and that #147019 later moved the same call into a helper. The sweeper predates the available July history, and the offline history could not establish when it first became possible to delete another unfinished handoff.
